decisions_made: Roster source-of-truth: merged the world-engine.jsx ids (cleaner snake_case, repo-aligned) with the engine/data.js schema (blurb, flavor, tag) rather than picking one wholesale.
Roster corrections: transition -> transition_ease for id consistency, follow_thru -> follow_through for spelling, Physical Restless. -> Physical Restlessness for truncation.
Placement: prototypes/world-engine/ as a sister to apps/ rather than apps/world-view/ because no build pipeline or workspace integration is planned in this PR.
No build pipeline: kept React + Babel via CDN per the no-wiring scope. Promoting to apps/ with a real bundler is a follow-up.
No API wiring: data.js is the only data source; window.WE_DATA stays as the global namespace contract. The EventKind-to-SignalType mapping in the spec doc is documentation only.
Drafts preservation: all original zip contents kept under _drafts/ verbatim so the design history is not lost.
